# FLUID contract cheat sheet (schema 0.7.6)

The values `fluid validate` accepts, read from the schema it checks an untagged
contract against. Anything not listed here is either free text or refused.
Full field reference: https://agenticstiger.github.io/forge_docs/reference/contract-0.7.6.html

## Top level

- Required: `fluidVersion`, `kind`, `id`, `name`, `metadata`, `exposes`.
- `fluidVersion`: `0.7.3`, `0.7.4`, `0.7.5`, `0.7.6`. Write `0.7.6`.
- `kind`: `DataProduct`, `MLPipeline`.
- All keys: `extensions`, `fluidVersion`, `kind`, `id`, `name`, `description`, `domain`, `tags`, `labels`, `metadata`, `exposes`, `consumes`, `builds`, `build`, `lineage`, `schemaEvolution`, `machineLearning`, `environments`, `lifecycle`, `docs`, `sovereignty`, `accessPolicy`, `orchestration`, `retention`, `consumers`, `governance`, `packaging`.
- Ids (`id`, `exposeId`, build `id`, `productId`) match `^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[A-Za-z0-9_]$|^[A-Za-z0-9_]$`.

## metadata

- Required: `owner`.
- `owner` keys (none required): `team`, `email`, `slack`, `oncall`.
- `productType`: `SDP`, `ADP`, `CDP`.
- `layer` is free text; with `productType` set it must be the canonical pair:
  `Bronze` = `SDP`, `Silver` = `ADP`, `Gold` = `CDP`.
- `classification`: `public`, `internal`, `confidential`, `restricted`.

## exposes[]

- Required: `exposeId`, `kind`, `binding`, `contract`.
- `kind`: `table`, `view`, `api`, `file`, `stream`, `topic`, `feature_store`, `model`, `vector`, `graph`, `time_series`, `other`.
- `binding` required: `platform`, `format`, `location`.
- `binding.platform`: `gcp`, `aws`, `azure`, `snowflake`, `databricks`, `kafka`, `confluent`, `local`, `kubernetes`, `postgres`, `pgvector`, `other`.
- `binding.format`: `bigquery_table`, `snowflake_table`, `snowflake_view`, `gcs_file`, `s3_file`, `http_api`, `grpc_api`, `pubsub_topic`, `kafka_topic`, `delta_table`, `iceberg`, `parquet`, `csv`, `json`, `redshift_table`, `redshift_serverless`, `redshift_external_schema`, `postgres_table`, `athena_table`, `glue_table`, `pgvector_table`, `other`.
- `binding.location` keys (none required, no others allowed): `account`, `project`, `dataset`, `database`, `schema`, `table`, `bucket`, `path`, `gateway`, `host`, `baseUrl`, `topic`, `subscription`, `region`, `zone`, `environment_id`, `kafka_cluster_id`, `stream`, `namespace`, `workgroup`, `iam_role_arn`, `external_schema`, `glue_database`, `confluent_role_arn`, `catalog`, `warehouse`, `uri`, `partitionBy`.

### Columns: `exposes[].contract.schema[]`

- Required: `name`, `type`. Keys: `name`, `type`, `required`, `description`, `sensitivity`, `semanticType`, `businessName`, `businessDefinition`, `validationRules`, `quality`, `tags`, `labels`.
- `type` (case-insensitive; parameterised forms such as `decimal(18,4)` and
  `varchar(255)` are accepted): `string`, `text`, `varchar`, `varchar2`, `nvarchar`, `char`, `nchar`, `character`, `clob`, `int`, `integer`, `int2`, `int4`, `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`, `tinyint`, `smallint`, `mediumint`, `bigint`, `long`, `longint`, `serial`, `bigserial`, `float`, `float4`, `float8`, `float32`, `float64`, `double`, `real`, `decimal`, `dec`, `numeric`, `number`, `bignumeric`, `money`, `boolean`, `bool`, `bit`, `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `datetime2`, `smalldatetime`, `timestamp`, `timestamptz`, `timestamp_tz`, `timestamp_ntz`, `timestamp_ltz`, `timestampntz`, `interval`, `year`, `variant`, `object`, `array`, `struct`, `map`, `record`, `row`, `json`, `jsonb`, `super`, `binary`, `varbinary`, `bytes`, `blob`, `bytea`, `raw`, `geography`, `geometry`, `geom`, `point`, `uuid`, `uniqueidentifier`, `guid`, `enum`, `hll`.
- `sensitivity`: `none`, `internal`, `confidential`, `restricted`, `pii`, `phi`, `cleartext`, `treated`, `anonymized`, `pseudonymized`, `tokenized`, `encrypted`.

### Quality rules

- `exposes[].contract.dq.rules[]` is what the quality engine runs.
  Required: `id`, `type`, `severity`.
  `type`: `freshness`, `completeness`, `uniqueness`, `valid_values`, `accuracy`, `schema`, `anomaly_detection`, `drift_detection`.
  `operator`: `>=`, `>`, `<=`, `<`, `==`, `!=`.
  `severity`: `info`, `warn`, `error`, `critical`.
  `selector` names the column; `threshold` is a number; `window` is an ISO-8601
  duration such as `P1D`.
- `exposes[].contract.schema[].quality[]` is the ODCS v3.1.0 shape, exported as-is.
  `type`: `text`, `library`, `sql`, `custom`.
  Library `metric`: `nullValues`, `missingValues`, `invalidValues`, `duplicateValues`, `rowCount`.
  Comparison (exactly one): `mustBe`, `mustNotBe`, `mustBeGreaterThan`, `mustBeGreaterOrEqualTo`, `mustBeLessThan`, `mustBeLessOrEqualTo`, `mustBeBetween`, `mustNotBeBetween`.
  `dimension`: `accuracy`, `completeness`, `conformity`, `consistency`, `coverage`, `timeliness`, `uniqueness`.
- `exposes[].contract.quality[]` is an inline SQL assertion.
  Required: `rule`, `expression`, `severity`.
  `severity`: `error`, `warning`, `info`.

## builds[]

- `pattern`: `hybrid-reference`, `embedded-logic`, `multi-stage`, `acquisition`.
- `engine`: `dbt`, `sql`, `python`, `spark`, `glue`, `custom`, `duckdb`, `airbyte`, `meltano`, `dlt`, `kafka-connect`, `debezium`, `flink`.
- `execution.trigger.type`: `schedule`, `event`, `manual`, `dependency`, `dataset`, `schedule_and_dataset`, `timetable`, `continuous`.
  A `schedule` trigger takes a five-field `cron`, for example `0 2 * * *`.
- `execution.runtime.platform`: `gcp`, `aws`, `azure`, `local`, `kubernetes`, `composer`, `mwaa`, `databricks`, `snowflake`, `athena`, `glue`, `redshift`.

## consumes[]

- Required: `productId`, `exposeId`. `productId` is the upstream
  contract's `id`; `exposeId` is one of its `exposes[].exposeId`.
- Keys: `productId`, `exposeId`, `contractId`, `versionConstraint`, `contractVersion`, `qosExpectations`, `requiredPolicies`, `purpose`, `tags`, `labels`, `upstreamWorkspace`, `upstreamDigest`.
